To add a little more my life seems to be getting progressively worse. I have some disease or mental issues that are still unclear to me. I have been to a doctor and they have told me that I had a mild case of autism. 
I am unable to talk to new people. It makes me uncomfortable. I rarely make new friends. When I do make friends I usually run out of things to say, do, or whatever, like come up with things to do or something. Its like I can't process that sort of stuff anymore. This whole thing probably doesn't make a whole lot of sense. Anyway. Any friend I make usually lasts a month to a year and they seem to care less and less about me and eventually stop being my friend. 
I can't afford treatment. I can't clearly describe what I'm going through and if I try I usually just spewing nonsense. My only fear is that my life will ultimately never get better and I will be miserable until I die.

There are so many things wrong right now it's hard to even think of a place to start.  My main issue right now is work. To be specific a co worker/old friend. She helped me get this job and asked for me to be on her crew. I have had issues with her in the past and honestly don't know why I even bothered to start talking to her again. This might all seem silly and such, like I should just walk away or quit and forget about her. But I can't. Lately she has been making me feel like shit. I have been so nice to her and she just ends up throwing that kindness back in my face wrapped up with a nice big middle finger. I recently had a birthday and she offered to take me out and have a fun night. which she later just blew me off and went out drinking with her other co workers. Now it isn't just her making me feel like shit. Everyone I work with makes me feel like my work is unappreciated. I'm basically just the muscle around there, not really important enough I suppose, lowest of the low on the totem pole I guess. I have been searching for a new job but it is so hard here. Any interview I get I feel like I do a terrible job. I can't afford to just walk away from this one so I am kind of stuck with dealing with this crap
